title: TradeObservation
description: A single observed trade, held as structured fields rather than prose. EvidenceItem already carries the CATEGORICAL trade context (marketSymbol, timeframe, session, direction) but has no numeric properties at all, so entry/stop/target/size/pnl had nowhere to live -- the gap MOGO-019 hit when six operator screenshots could not be ingested, and the same gap that leaves MOGO's own decisions absent from the corpus (0 of 416 evidence items are replay_result or paper_trade_result). One record type serves both, because a human's screenshotted trade and a MOGO decision are the same SHAPE; they differ only in actor and provenance. RESEARCH ONLY: a TradeObservation is evidence, never a rule and never an instruction to trade.

actor.description: Who made this decision. The single field that lets one record type serve both operator-supplied trades and MOGO's own decisions.

sourceId.description: The EvidenceSource holding the preserved original (screenshot bytes, decision record). Lane A already preserves non-text bytes: repositoryPath + contentHash require nothing textual.

sourcePackageId.description: The exact source artifact this observation was derived from, e.g. an evidence package id (PKG|...). sourceId identifies the registered EvidenceSource; this identifies the individual record inside it, so provenance is exact rather than only file-level.

sourceContentHash.description: SHA-256 of the source artifact, copied as stored and never recomputed. This is the GLOBAL identity of the record an observation was derived from. sourcePackageId is NOT globally unique -- a package id is PKG|<strategy>|<date>|<ordinal> where the ordinal only counts within one capture run, so a REPLAY_RUN and a LIVE_CLOSE package can share one. Deduplicating an import on the package id therefore silently drops genuinely distinct decisions.

evidenceItemIds.description: Backing EvidenceItems, typically evidenceType chart_example or trade_example.

exitPriceBasis.description: R-6. The engine's statement of how the BOOKED exitPrice relates to the market, on a historical-candle exit (v12.42.0 D2 and later). trigger_level: the exit candle traded through the trigger, and the booked price is the trigger. candle_open_gap: the candle OPENED beyond the trigger, so the booked trigger price is one the market never traded; see exitModeledExecutablePrice. Absent or null means UNKNOWN, never 'no gap': pre-v12.42 engines and live-snapshot exits do not state one.

exitTriggerLevel.description: R-6. The stop or target level that fired. On a historical-candle exit the booked exitPrice equals it, under the frozen fixed-R convention.

exitModeledExecutablePrice.description: R-6. The engine's MODEL of the price the market could have filled: the open of the exit M1 candle on the closing side, clamped at the trigger. A model, NOT a quote and NOT a fill; MOGO places no broker orders. Copied from the package field exitExecutablePrice, and renamed so it cannot be read as an executed price.

exitGapPips.description: R-6. |exitModeledExecutablePrice - exitTriggerLevel| in pips, as the engine stated it. 0 is a measured zero (exitPriceBasis trigger_level). Absent is UNKNOWN.

exitGapR.description: R-6. exitGapPips / risk pips, as the engine stated it. Engine-modelled; never booked and never subtracted from pnl.

exitQuoteBid.description: R-6. The live bid OBSERVED at a live-snapshot exit (package exitBid). An observed quote, not a fill.

exitQuoteAsk.description: R-6. The live ask OBSERVED at a live-snapshot exit (package exitAsk). An observed quote, not a fill.

exitQuoteSpreadPips.description: R-6. The spread of that observed quote, in pips (package exitSpreadPips).

recordedResultR.description: R-6. The ledger's fixed-R result label (package recordedResultR: -1 or plannedRR). It can differ from rMultiple, which is computed from the booked price. On a live-snapshot exit rMultiple includes the slippage and this label does not.

closedAtBasis.description: What closedAt means on this record, copied from the package's exitTimestampBasis. exit_detected_at (v12.42.0 D4): the minute-aligned MARKET exit. Absent: the original meaning, the moment the close was RECORDED. Minted since R-3; documented here at R-6.

capturedAt.description: The package capture time (package createdAt): an upper bound on when the ledger applied the close. Minted since R-3; documented here at R-6.

sequenceId.description: Groups observations that belong to one trade sequence, e.g. a multi-screenshot series.

decisionTaken.description: For decision-difference work: a DECLINED or NO_SETUP observation is evidence too, and is the half usually missing.

fieldClassification.description: Per-field provenance classification. REQUIRED, and it is the point of this record type: a number read off a screenshot is DIRECTLY_OBSERVED, a number the trader said is SOURCE_STATED, a number MOGO computed is INFERRED. Flattening these is how an inference silently becomes a source-stated fact.

inferenceReasons.description: Maps each field classified INFERRED to the basis for the inference. Required for every INFERRED field and permitted for no other: an inference that cannot state its basis is not evidence, and must never be stored where a source-stated fact would sit.

extractedBy.description: What performed the extraction, e.g. 'claude-opus-5 vision (operator-supplied screenshot)' or 'mogo-engine 12.39.1'. Never omit: an extractor is part of provenance.

unknowns.description: REQUIRED and may not be silently empty-by-default. What this observation does NOT establish. Mirrors the rule-candidate convention: a record with nothing unknown is usually a record that stopped looking.

lane.description: Pinned. A TradeObservation never promotes anything and never authorises a trade.

marketExitAt.description: The candle boundary on which the exit ACTUALLY occurred, as stated by the evidence package (exitCandleEnd), converted from epoch milliseconds. Distinct from closedAt, which is when the close was RECORDED: for an exit reconstructed from candles that is when the re-walk noticed it, observed up to 351.8 hours later. Both are kept; neither corrects the other. Holding periods must be computed from this field, not from closedAt. UNKNOWN when the package states no candle boundary.

exitDetectionSource.description: How the exit was detected -- e.g. historical_candle (reconstructed on a re-walk) or live_snapshot. Recorded because it determines whether closedAt can be read as a market time at all.

executionProvenance.description: R-6. What KIND of execution this record's outcome is. MOGO-only. MOGO is a simulator: it places no broker orders, so no MOGO record is broker-filled or execution-verified, and trade_observation refuses any that claims to be. Booked figures (exitPrice, pnl, rMultiple, accountBalanceAfter) are SIMULATOR_BOOKED. They are never 'realized execution', and trade_observation.execution_verified_pnl() refuses to aggregate them as such. Absent on records written before R-6.

executionKind.description: SIMULATED when the package states identity.mode LIVE_PAPER or REPLAY. UNKNOWN when it states no mode. Any other mode is refused at import.

brokerFill.description: NONE for SIMULATED, UNKNOWN for UNKNOWN. No other value is permitted.

fieldRoles.description: For each recorded booked, modelled or quoted value, which of those it is. The roles are fixed per field (trade_observation.FIELD_ROLES). Empty when executionKind is UNKNOWN.
